# Skills Index

Check this file before building a new workflow from scratch.

| Skill | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| [project-starter](./project-starter/SKILL.md) | Start a new tracked project in this workspace | When a new real project begins |
| [skill-authoring](./skill-authoring/SKILL.md) | Add a reusable local skill | When a repeated workflow should become reusable |

## Rules

1. Reuse before re-creating.
2. Keep each skill in `.github/agents/skills/<skill-name>/`.
3. Every skill directory must include `SKILL.md`.
4. Update this index whenever a skill is added, renamed, or removed.
